description: This file defines a console command class `RunMigrationClassCommand` in the PHP project, used to run database migration classes within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system's development tools. The class handles command-line arguments, validates migration class types, initializes necessary application components, executes migrations, and updates configuration.

classes.name: RunMigrationClassCommand
classes.description: A Symfony console command to run specified migration classes in the OrangeHRM project, handling validation, execution, and configuration updates.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Sets up the command's description, help text, and required arguments.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Executes the command: validates the application state, checks the migration class, initializes kernel, runs migration, and updates configuration.
